trade_offs.description: Post content stays inline: wp_posts averages 711 bytes per item against the 400 KB item limit.
trade_offs.impact: No S3 offload is needed for posts.

trade_offs.description: No GSI is created on autoload, because no in-scope query filters on it.
trade_offs.impact: The source's autoload index is dropped.

trade_offs.description: Option values stay inline: the measured average row is 360 bytes against the 400 KB item limit.
trade_offs.impact: Writes larger than 400 KB are rejected; the application checks the size first.
